name: Weather modal bracket taker
description: Taker: 24-36 h before the close of a KXHIGH* city-day, buy YES at the ask on the highest-priced bracket (once per event), hold to settlement.
hypothesis: Early KXHIGH ladders are too wide (implied variance ~1.4x realised), so the modal bracket wins slightly more than its price: dev screen +0.4..+1.7c/ct net of fee, day-clustered se ~1c. Wrong if the walk-forward pooled CI <= 0 or 2x latency loses; the edge is small so inconclusive is likely.
